newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: France's Giat in offset deal in UAE.
newsitem.headline: France's Giat in offset deal in UAE.

text.p: France's Giat Industries on Monday announced the setting up of a marble, granite and stone manufacturing and processing firm in the United Arab Emirates under a 1993 tank deal offset obligation.
The company -- CIA.MAR Emirates Marble, Granite and Stone Industry LLC -- has a paid up capital of $14.8 million and the total cost of the project is $37 million, it said.

Long-term financing of $22.2 million is being arranged with UAE and international banks, Giat added. The new company will be owned by Giat, UAE partners and Italian firm Marble and Granite Industries Holdings.
The plant in Abu Dhabi will process one million square metres of marble and granite a year and construction is due to be completed by the end of 1997.
Offset officials estimated that after three years of production turnover will amount to $60 million a year.
Giat clinched a $3.62 billion deal in 1993 to supply the UAE with battle tanks, and industry sources say it has been struggling to fulfill its offset obligations.
